desc:
<A:Q16> looks weird but leaves White with exploitable cutting points and is the preferred move post-AlphaGo.

<B:P14> is the old joseki, which professional players stopped playing in 2017.

<C:Q15> is slow and not recommended.

See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 35, AlphaGo Master (W) vs. Jiang Weijie 9p (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zjEZDmYqRPg&t=563s).
